NGN.subsidy: Nigeria's Presidential Fertilizer Initiative (PFI) may reduce cost by 25-40%. Check with your state ADP.

KES.subsidy: Kenya: NCPB subsidised fertilizer available via the National Fertilizer Subsidy Programme. Check county agricultural offices.

GHS.subsidy: Ghana: Planting for Food and Jobs (PFJ) programme provides subsidised fertilizer to registered farmers. Register at your district DADU.

ZAR.subsidy: South Africa: DAFF Comprehensive Agricultural Support Programme (CASP) provides input grants to smallholder farmers.

TZS.subsidy: Tanzania: National Agricultural Input Voucher Scheme (NAIVS) provides subsidised fertilizer. Register at your ward agricultural office.

UGX.subsidy: Uganda: NAADS/OWC programmes distribute subsidised inputs. Contact your sub-county agricultural officer.

USD.subsidy: Prices in USD. Check local government agricultural input programmes for subsidies in your country.

microTips.maize: Zinc (Zn) deficiency is common in maize, especially on sandy soils. Apply 5-10 kg ZnSO4/ha if leaves show white striping. Sulfur (S): 10-15 kg/ha on depleted soils.
microTips.rice: Zinc deficiency causes "khaira disease" in rice. Apply 5 kg ZnSO4/ha as basal. Silicon (Si): beneficial on weathered soils — rice straw incorporation helps.
microTips.cassava: Boron (B) deficiency can cause internal necrosis. Apply 1-2 kg borax/ha on acidic soils. Cassava is sulfur-sensitive — avoid excess sulfate fertilizers.
microTips.yam: Zinc and boron are key micronutrients. Apply 5 kg ZnSO4/ha and 1 kg borax/ha on laterite soils. Magnesium (Mg) deficiency shows as interveinal chlorosis.
microTips.sorghum: Zinc deficiency reduces tillering in sorghum. Apply 5 kg ZnSO4/ha on sandy soils. Iron (Fe) chlorosis may occur on high-pH calcareous soils in North Africa.
microTips.millet: Micronutrient needs are modest but zinc deficiency is common on Sahelian sandy soils. Apply 3-5 kg ZnSO4/ha as preventive measure.
microTips.cowpea: Molybdenum (Mo) is critical for nitrogen fixation in cowpea. Apply 100-200 g sodium molybdate/ha or treat seeds with Rhizobium inoculant.
microTips.groundnut: Calcium (Ca) and Boron (B) are critical for peg and pod development. Apply gypsum (200-400 kg/ha) at pegging and 1 kg borax/ha on deficient soils.
microTips.soybean: Molybdenum (Mo) supports N-fixation. Apply Bradyrhizobium seed inoculant. Iron deficiency chlorosis can occur on high-pH soils — use chelated Fe foliar spray.
microTips.cocoa: Boron deficiency causes "die-back". Apply 1-2 kg borax/ha annually. Zinc: 2-5 kg ZnSO4/ha. Magnesium deficiency is common in old plantations — apply dolomite.
microTips.coffee: Boron (1-2 kg borax/ha), Zinc (3-5 kg ZnSO4/ha), and Magnesium (15-20 kg MgSO4/ha) are the main micronutrients for coffee quality and berry set.
microTips.cotton: Boron (B) is critical for boll set — apply 1-2 kg borax/ha. Zinc deficiency causes "little leaf". Manganese (Mn) deficiency occurs on alkaline soils.
microTips.wheat: Zinc deficiency is widespread in North African wheat soils. Apply 10-15 kg ZnSO4/ha or foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO4 solution. Manganese deficiency on alkaline soils.
microTips.potato: Boron (1-2 kg borax/ha) prevents hollow heart. Zinc (5-10 kg ZnSO4/ha) improves tuber set. Magnesium deficiency causes early leaf senescence — apply Epsom salt.
microTips.tomato: Calcium deficiency causes blossom-end rot — maintain even soil moisture and foliar spray 0.4% CaCl2. Boron: 1-2 kg borax/ha. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha.
microTips.plantain: Magnesium is critical for chlorophyll and bunch weight. Apply 20-30 kg MgSO4/ha. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha. Boron helps fruit set: 1-2 kg borax/ha.
microTips.sweetpotato: Boron deficiency causes internal cork — apply 1 kg borax/ha. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha on sandy soils. Avoid excessive N which promotes vines over tubers.
microTips.onion: Sulfur (S) is critical for onion flavour and bulb development — apply 20-30 kg S/ha. Boron: 1-2 kg borax/ha. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha to prevent white tip.
microTips.capsicum: Calcium deficiency causes blossom-end rot — maintain even moisture and use CaNO3. Boron (1-2 kg borax/ha) improves fruit set. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha.
microTips.sugarcane: Silicon (Si) strengthens stalks and reduces pest pressure. Incorporate silica slag (200-400 kg/ha). Zinc: 5-10 kg ZnSO4/ha on deficient soils.
microTips.banana: Magnesium (MgO 30-50 kg/ha) is critical for leaf area index. Zinc (5-10 kg ZnSO4/ha) prevents "little leaf" disease. Boron improves bunch filling.
microTips.sunflower: Boron is critical for pollen viability and seed set — apply 1-2 kg borax/ha. Zinc: 5 kg ZnSO4/ha. Sulfur: 10-15 kg/ha improves oil quality.
